tiles.query: SELECT TOP 15001 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE ra>=80 AND ra<85 AND dec>=-10 AND dec<-5 AND phot_g_mean_mag>7 AND phot_g_mean_mag<=11.5 ORDER BY source_id
